description: This file implements an adapter class for integrating AWS Bedrock Large Language Models (LLMs) into the Pipecat framework. It handles conversion of message formats, manages invocation parameters, and defines utility functions related to AWS Bedrock's API expectations within a structured LLM context.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMInvocationParams
classes.description: TypedDict defining the parameters for invoking AWS Bedrock's LLM API, including system messages, user messages, tools, and tool choice.

classes.name: AWSBedrockLLMAdapter
classes.description: Adapter class for integrating AWS Bedrock LLM with Pipecat, capable of converting message formats, preparing invocation parameters, and handling logging.

classes.name: ConvertedMessages
classes.description: Dataclass serving as a container for messages converted from a universal context into AWS Bedrock-compatible format, including an optional system message.

methods.name: str id_for_llm_specific_messages(self)
methods.description: Returns a string identifier ('aws') used in LLM specific messages for this adapter.

methods.name: AWSBedrockLLMInvocationParams get_llm_invocation_params(self, context: LLMContext)
methods.description: Generates and returns the invocation parameters for AWS Bedrock based on the provided LLM context.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_messages_for_logging(self, context)
methods.description: Prepares messages from the LLM context in a sanitized format suitable for logging, removing or truncating sensitive data such as images.

methods.name: ConvertedMessages _from_universal_context_messages( self, universal_context_messages: List[LLMContextMessage] )
methods.description: Converts a list of universal LLM context messages into AWS Bedrock format, merging and transforming messages as needed.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _from_universal_context_message(self, message: LLMContextMessage)
methods.description: Converts a single universal context message into AWS Bedrock format, handling specific message types.

methods.name: dict[str,Any] _from_standard_message(self, message: LLMStandardMessage)
methods.description: Converts a standard format message into AWS Bedrock message format, processing content, tool calls, and images.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _to_bedrock_function_format(function: FunctionSchema)
methods.description: Converts a FunctionSchema into Bedrock's tool specification format.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema)
methods.description: Converts a ToolsSchema into a list of Bedrock-compatible tool definitions.

ctags.name: to_provider_tools_format
ctags.pattern: /^    def to_provider_tools_format(self, tools_schema: ToolsSchema) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:$/
